title: Invalid free() in TUI in rpc_send_event() when calling `nvim_input`

labels.name: needs:repro
labels.description: We need minimal steps to reproduce the issue

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:

This has just happened the first time. I cannot recall what key I pressed when this crash happened.

### Expected behavior

No crash
